info.title: lightsdk-gateway API
info.description:
REST gateway in front of a private rgb-node-api service that hosts one watch-only rgb-lib wallet per user. Neither the gateway nor rgb-node-api holds keys: an on-chain operation is prepared here, signed by the client, and completed here.

## Authentication

Users send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. `POST /v1/users` issues tokens and takes the operator token in `x-operator-token`.

## Idempotency

The prepare and complete routes require an `Idempotency-Key` header of 1 to 128 characters, scoped to the user. A retry with the same key and the same request (method, route and body) returns the stored response, error responses included, marked `x-idempotent-replay: true`. The same key on a different request answers 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`. Responses with status 429 or 5xx are not stored, so that request can be retried under the same key. A key whose request never finished can be reclaimed by the same request after 15 minutes. Stored responses are kept for 7 days.

## Errors

Error bodies are `{"error": {"code", "message"}}`; branch on `code`. Every response carries an `x-request-id` header. Error details stay in the gateway's log under that id, so quote it to an operator. A path the gateway does not serve answers Fastify's default 404 body instead.

## Requests

JSON bodies of at most 64 KiB. Unknown fields in a body or query string are removed before processing, not rejected. Amounts are JSON numbers: sats for BTC, asset units for RGB.

post.description: Builds an unsigned PSBT that sends `amount` of `assetId` to the invoice's `recipientId`, with the RGB commitment already embedded. `intent` lets the client check the bitcoin side; the RGB transition itself is opaque to it. recipientId.description: Recipient id from the recipient's invoice (blinded UTXO or witness).

witnessAmountSat.description: Sats for the witness output. Give it for a witness recipient only.

transportEndpoints.description: Consignment endpoints, each on the operator's allowlist. Default: the gateway's `RGB_PROXY_URL`.

recipientPublicKey.description: The recipient invoice's `pk` (Ed25519, 32 bytes as lowercase hex). Required by an RGB proxy protocol 1.0 wallet service.

recipientEncryption.description: The recipient invoice's `enc`: absent is `required`, `1` is `optional`, `0` is `unsupported`. Omit it when the invoice has none.

donation.description: rgb-lib donation: don't wait for the recipient's acknowledgement. Default false.

minConfirmations.description: Confirmations required on the spent inputs. Default 1.

get.description:
The durable record of a prepared operation, for a client that lost the outcome of `complete`. Takes no `Idempotency-Key` and doesn't wait behind the user's queued wallet work, so it answers while a `complete` is still running. It never returns the PSBT.

| `state` | `mayHaveBroadcast` | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `completed` | `false` | Done; `txid` is final. |
| `pending` | `false` | Prepared, never broadcast: sign and complete it, or let it expire. |
| `pending` | `true` | The transaction may be on the network. The gateway finishes the bookkeeping itself; poll until `completed`. |
| `expired` | `false` | Expired without being broadcast; prepare again. |
| `expired` | `true` | Past `expiresAt` while ambiguous. The gateway still finishes it. |

txid.description: Final txid once completed; the txid that may have broadcast while ambiguous; otherwise null.

mayHaveBroadcast.description: True when the op is not completed but a txid is recorded: its transaction may already be on the network.

Assignment.description: An rgb-lib assignment: its variant name plus its fungible amount.

amount.description: Fungible amount; null for a variant that carries none.

OnchainIntent.description: What the client checks the PSBT against before signing. Built from the request and the gateway's config, never read back from the PSBT.

feeRateSatPerVb.description: Fee rate the PSBT was built with.

recipients.description: BTC payments: one for send-btc, none otherwise.

scriptHex.description: Output script the address decodes to, hex.

asset.description: The RGB payment of a send-asset; null otherwise.

witnessAmountSat.description: Sats on the witness output; null for a blinded recipient.

transportEndpoints.description: Consignment endpoints the transfer is posted to.

recipientPublicKey.description: The recipient invoice's `pk` the consignment is encrypted to, as sent; null when not given.

recipientExpirationTimestamp.description: The recipient invoice's `expiry`, as sent; null when not given.

recipientEncryption.description: The recipient invoice's `enc`, as sent; null when not given.

utxos.description: The UTXOs a create-utxos makes; null otherwise.

opId.description: Operation id (a UUID) returned by prepare.

psbt.description: Unsigned PSBT, base64. Check it against `intent`.

expiresAt.description: Unix milliseconds. Completing after this fails with 410 `OP_EXPIRED`.

opId.description: Operation id (a UUID) returned by prepare.

signedPsbt.description: The prepared PSBT with the client's signatures, base64. Same txid as prepared.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen key for one logical operation, scoped to the user. Reuse it only to retry the same request.

RequestId.description: Random id of this request; the gateway logs error details under it.

IdempotentReplay.description: Present, as `true`, when this is a stored response being replayed.
